counterfactual_missing_items: peripheral eosinophilia or elevated IgE for Kimura disease
sicca symptoms or anti-SSA/SSB for Sjögren's syndrome
elevated serum IgG4 or storiform fibrosis for IgG4-related disease
decisive_items: An incisional biopsy suggested myositis with lymphoid hyperplasia
soft-tissue density lesion in the left premaxillary region
a gradually enlarging swelling of the left cheek
response.rationale: C1 is the append-only completion of R2, combining the biopsy-supported myositis with the left maxillary location. R3 and other alternatives rely on nonspecific lymphoid hyperplasia without characteristic clinical or histologic features, whereas C1 directly matches the biopsy and imaging localization.

rejected.why: Superseded by C1; same diagnosis without anatomical localization.
Only lymphoid hyperplasia; no emperipolesis, S100 positivity, or massive lymphadenopathy.
Only lymphoid hyperplasia; no IgG4-related histology or organ involvement.
Only lymphoid hyperplasia; no sicca symptoms or autoimmune serology.
